bifrost: bifrost_app::locale, bifrost_app::time_zone, bifrost_app::coding, bifrost_app::attributed, bifrost_ui::calendar, bifrost_ui::format, bifrost_ui::table, bifrost_ui::diff, bifrost_ui::geometry
summary: Locale-aware number, date, byte, measurement and list formatting, Gregorian calendar math, sort descriptors and Codable-style coding exist. Time zones exist as TimeZone (identifiers from the system tz database, offsets, daylight saving, transitions). Apps get no predicate or expression engine, no regex or natural-language API, no non-Gregorian calendars, and no full Data/Decimal/UUID/IndexSet type family (Rust std covers some of it).
